summary: A record's state as one word.
not_for: A category, a count or a call to action.

rules.rule: One word; two only for a compound state.
An adjective, a completed form (返金済み) or, for a state in progress, ○○中 (回答中), from a fixed vocabulary per object (voice.status).
One colour per state, the same on every screen.

evidence.says: Badge text is one word, two for complex states, in the past tense or as an adjective (Refunded, not Refund); one tone per status.
A tag shows a status in sentence case and is not interactive.

evidence.source: SmartHR Design System, ステータス
evidence.says: Name a status label for the progress of the task or the action asked of the reader; a state in progress takes ○○中 (依頼準備中, 入力中, 回答中).
